svg.font-family: 'Segoe UI', 'Noto Sans', 'DejaVu Sans', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif
svg.text: PR #1811 · Require a committed visual summary on every PR
Visual summaries lived one session in /tmp and depended on agent discipline; each PR now
commits its own SVG where review opens on it, enforced by a reusable checked requirement.

g.text: visual-pr skill → /tmp → agent-portal show
the SVG rendered once, inline in the portal session
SKILL.md step 6: "keep the repo clean — do not commit generated SVGs"
GitHub review sees none of it
the PR page is text only — the diagram never reaches the reviewer
and the convention was AGENTS.md prose: skipping it failed nothing
coverage = agent discipline
a forgotten visual is silent; the artifact evaporates with the session
no history, no enforcement, no reviewer-facing copy
000-pr-visualization/<pr-number>.svg — committed
the 000- prefix sorts first in "Files changed" — review opens on it
merged SVGs accumulate as a visual history (~6-10 KB of text each)
meawoppl/visual-pr@v1 — reusable required check
validates with check_svg.py against this repo's style artifact
(.github/visual-pr/style.json) + injectable custom instructions
on failure it teaches the agent: spec + effective style + the exact
local check to run before pushing — the red X carries its own fix
pull_request_target: reports on every open PR at merge; head is data only

svg.text: no-visual label opts out — skipped job

g.text: every PR opens on its own picture
this file is the first instance — the PR you are reviewing ships it
any repo can adopt the action; the style and instructions are theirs

svg.text: Not yet in pr-to-main's required list — 13 PRs are open and would strand; flip the ruleset when the queue drains. Dotfile paths still sort before 000-.
